source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "ដំណាំក្រូចថ្លុង" (Pomelo Cultivation Guide), 2017, 90pp
text:
Pomelo is grown in various regions of Cambodia, typically alongside other fruit trees, and does well in a tropical climate with adequate year-round water. As with other citrus, orchard sites are best chosen on land that does not flood and that is protected from strong wind, near a dependable water source for the dry season.

The source notes that established pomelo orchards are often planted in mixed home-garden or orchard settings rather than as large single-crop blocks, and that surrounding vegetation and windbreaks help protect trees from wind damage and extreme temperature swings.
